# BGET Welcome Messages

---

## A. Membership Screening (short form — Discord screen)

> **Welcome to BGET**
>
> **B**uild. **G**row. **E**volve. **T**ogether.
>
> A community for capable people who believe capability without character isn't enough.
>
> **Five rules:**
> 1. Be kind. Disagree with ideas, never people.
> 2. Be honest. No deception, no impersonation.
> 3. Be useful. Contribute more than you extract.
> 4. Be humble. No résumé spam, no gatekeeping.
> 5. Be responsible. Our actions matter even when nobody is watching.
>
> **What we ask:** show up, stay humble, leave it better.
> **What you get:** people who make you better, judged by conduct not credentials,
> and help when you ask.
>
> ✅ I've read this and I agree to it.

---

## B. Bot DM — sent immediately on join

> Hey {name} — welcome to BGET 👋
>
> Two things, then you're in:
>
> **1.** Post an introduction in `#introductions` using this format:
> ```
> 🌱 Name / location / timezone
> 🔧 What I'm building or learning right now
> 🎯 What I want to get better at
> 🤝 How I can help someone here
> ```
>
> **2.** Find one thread this week where you can help somebody. Even a short,
> useful answer counts.
>
> A human will reply to your intro — not a bot. If you've got questions,
> just ask in `#questions`. Nothing here is too basic.
>
> — BGET

---

## C. Reply to a new introduction (human — use within 24h)

> Welcome {name} — good to have you.
>
> {one specific, personal observation from their intro — NOT a generic "glad to have you"}
>
> Two things you might want this week:
> → {relevant channel or thread}
> → Our next **Build Night** is {day/time}. We build together on mic —
>   bring anything, even if it's half-finished. That's the norm here.
>
> If you're stuck on anything, post it in `#questions`. Someone will pick it up.

*Rule: no introduction goes unanswered for more than 24 hours. Ever.*

---

## D. Day 3 check-in (bot)

> {name}, quick one — what are you working on right now?
>
> Post it in `#goals` in one or two lines. Doesn't need to be polished.
> Weekly goals in public here are how people find each other in BGET.

---

## E. Day 30 — trial complete (human/bot)

> {name} — you've been here 30 days, so this is the official bit:
>
> You're now a full **@Member**. That means referral slots, Labs access when
> it opens, and eligibility for Guide/Steward roles down the line.
>
> Three asks as a full member:
> 1. Post your weekly goal in `#goals`
> 2. Use your one referral slot on someone you'd genuinely vouch for
> 3. Help someone this week without being asked
>
> Glad you're here.

---

## F. Rejection (personal, warm, no false hope)

> Hi {name} — thanks for the honest answers, genuinely.
>
> BGET is deliberately small right now, and I'm only able to bring in people I
> can actually spend time with. That's a reflection of where we are, not a
> verdict on you.
>
> You're welcome to re-apply in 90 days. In the meantime, two things I think
> you'd get a lot out of: {one genuinely relevant resource}.
>
> I mean it about re-applying — {one specific thing from their answers that
> was actually good}.
>
> — {you}
